title: Django 5.1.6 release notes | Django documentation | Django
content:
Django 5.1.6 fixes several bugs in 5.1.5.

Fixed a regression in Django 5.1.5 that caused validate_ipv6_address() and validate_ipv46_address() to crash when handling non-string values (#36098).

Fixed a regression in Django 5.1 where password fields, despite being set to required=False, were still treated as required in forms derived from BaseUserCreationForm (#36140).
